title: 2010 Dakar Rally
who: Won by Carlos Sainz / Lucas Cruz (Volkswagen) and Cyril Despres (KTM)
summary: The 2010 edition of the Dakar Rally, in its South America era: 15 stage towns and bivouacs through Argentina, Chile. Winners — Cars: Carlos Sainz / Lucas Cruz (Volkswagen); Bikes: Cyril Despres (KTM); Quads: Marcos Patronelli (Yamaha); Trucks: Vladimir Chagin / Sergey Savostin / Eduard Nikolaev (Kamaz).
approximate: Stage towns and bivouacs from Wikipedia's stage table. The rally ran off-road between them, so the lines are straight from bivouac to bivouac.
